engine_detail: InstallShield 5 self-extracting package: MSZIP cabinet with Disk1/Setup.exe (PE32), _Setup.dll (PE32), _ISDel.exe (PE32), SETUP.INI (AppName "Heroes of Might and Magic III Demo"), data1.cab/_sys1.cab/_user1.cab; the bootstrapper extracts to TEMP and runs Setup.exe.

variants.name: silent-candidate
variants.source: InstallShield 5 Setup.exe -s runs silently with a recorded setup.iss (-r); no response file exists until a reference run, so this variant only measures the bootstrapper

expected.reason: no reference installation on a qualified system yet (f5-02B/15B); the lead pins files, registry, links, restart and uninstall residue from the QEMU installers tier

notes: The package extracts Disk1 to TEMP on the adapter; the message pump then needs the USER queue (W32_MESSAGE).
